verdict.rationale: Trivy ships a first-party MCP server (trivy-mcp) that lets a connected LLM 'ask questions about security issues in natural language,' and this was hands-on verified to start and handshake correctly, giving AI agents access to scan data for AI-generated insights. However, Trivy itself doesn't natively generate insights/suggestions (e.g., remediation advice) — the AI generation is entirely delegated to whatever external LLM connects via MCP. Missing for 10: native AI-generated remediation/insight generation inside Trivy, evidence of actual insight quality/output from a connected LLM, and any UI-embedded AI assistant.
